english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for a bottle and can also mean a bottleful in phrases such as 一樽啤酒.

exampleSentences.english: There’s a bottle of iced lemon tea on the table.
exampleSentences.jyutping: toi4 min6 jau5 jat1 zeon1 dung3 ling4 caa4

english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a jar or similar container.

exampleSentences.english: There’s a jar of jam in the kitchen.
exampleSentences.jyutping: cyu4 fong2 jau5 jat1 zeon1 gwo2 zoeng3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a general narrow-necked container, rather than a laboratory or drinking-specific flask.

exampleSentences.english: This flask is used to hold hot water.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 zeon1 jung6 lai4 zong1 jit6 seoi2
